consoleSettings.sdl:
version: '2.0'
services:
  catalog:
    image: docker.io/library/python@sha256:69ebe56e2a764c399514a0a6117131cb730cc4d0e71e85c08deb9af74cbb9f41
    command:
      - python
      - '-u'
      - '-c'
    args:
      - exec(__import__('base64').b64decode(''))
    env:
      - ARKHE_PUBLIC_ARTIFACT_B64=ac-secret://s0_e0
      - PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=ac-secret://s0_e1
    expose:
      - port: 8080
        as: 80
        to:
          - global: true
profiles:
  compute:
    catalog:
      resources:
        cpu:
          units: 0.25
        memory:
          size: 256Mi
        storage:
          - size: 512Mi
  placement:
    akash:
      attributes:
        organization: Akash Palmito
      signedBy:
        anyOf:
          - akash1365yvmc4s7awdyj3n2sav7xfx76adc6dnmlx63
      pricing:
        catalog:
          denom: uact
          amount: 20
deployment:
  catalog:
    akash:
      profile: catalog
      count: 1

version: '2.0'
services:
  arkhe-verify:
    image: ghcr.io/arkhe-network/arkhe-verify:0.1.0
    expose:
      - port: 8080
        as: 80
        to:
          - global: true
    env:
      - MMRD_URL=http://arkhe-mmrd:8081
      - ARKHE_NETWORK=akash
      - RUST_LOG=info
  arkhe-mmrd:
    image: ghcr.io/arkhe-network/arkhe-mmrd:0.1.0
    expose:
      - port: 8081
        as: 8081
        to:
          - global: false
          - service: arkhe-verify
    env:
      - EVIDENCE_DIR=/var/lib/arkhe/evidence
      - RUST_LOG=info
    params:
      storage:
        evidence:
          mount: /var/lib/arkhe/evidence
          readOnly: false
  arkhe-anchor:
    image: ghcr.io/arkhe-network/arkhe-anchor:0.1.0
    expose:
      - port: 8082
        as: 8082
        to:
          - global: false
          - service: arkhe-mmrd
    env:
      - ANCHOR_MODE=rekor
      - REKOR_URL=https://rekor.sigstore.dev
      - MMRD_URL=http://arkhe-mmrd:8081
      - RUST_LOG=info
profiles:
  compute:
    arkhe-verify:
      resources:
        cpu:
          units: 0.5
        memory:
          size: 512Mi
        storage:
          - size: 512Mi
    arkhe-mmrd:
      resources:
        cpu:
          units: 1
        memory:
          size: 1Gi
        storage:
          - size: 1Gi
          - name: evidence
            size: 10Gi
            attributes:
              persistent: true
              class: beta3
    arkhe-anchor:
      resources:
        cpu:
          units: 0.25
        memory:
          size: 256Mi
        storage:
          - size: 256Mi
  placement:
    akash:
      pricing:
        arkhe-verify:
          denom: uakt
          amount: 1000
        arkhe-mmrd:
          denom: uakt
          amount: 2000
        arkhe-anchor:
          denom: uakt
          amount: 500
deployment:
  arkhe-verify:
    akash:
      profile: arkhe-verify
      count: 1
  arkhe-mmrd:
    akash:
      profile: arkhe-mmrd
      count: 1
  arkhe-anchor:
    akash:
      profile: arkhe-anchor
      count: 1
